title.value: Exploring trust development in families of children towards surgical and emergency care providers: A scoping review of the literature
title.justification: The extracted title accurately represents the scope and focus of the paper, which is on trust development in families towards surgical and emergency care providers.
title.quote: Exploring trust development in families of children towards surgical and emergency care providers: A scoping review of the literature

extractions.description: This paper conducts a scoping review to identify factors fostering trust development in pediatric surgical and urgent care settings. It explores the gap in literature about trust development in children facing surgical emergencies and identifies major constructs such as competence, communication, dependability, and caring as vital to establishing trust. The review aims to guide future educational interventions to strengthen parental trust and promote child- and family-centered care in pediatric settings.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on trust development in pediatric healthcare settings, an area unrelated to Climate Change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Trust is central to the therapeutic relationship between patients and their providers, yet little is known about how it is developed in the unique context of children facing surgical emergencies.

primary_category.justification: The paper doesn't align with any defined Climate Change category as it primarily deals with healthcare trust in pediatric surgery.
primary_category.quote: We sought to identify factors fostering trust development, gaps, and areas for improvement in pediatric surgical settings.

secondary_categories.justification: This paper does not address any secondary Climate Change themes. It is focused on healthcare and trust in surgical settings.
secondary_categories.quote: Our findings can guide future educational interventions towards strengthening parental trust and promoting child- and family-centered care in pediatric surgical settings.

primary_sub_category.justification: The content of the paper does not fit into any specific Climate Change sub-category as it focuses on healthcare.
primary_sub_category.quote: Trust is central to the therapeutic relationship between patients and their providers.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper does not cover any sub-categories related to Climate Change.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Improving communication and providing compassionate care, as well as encouraging a patient-centered approach, appear to be most effective in promoting trust.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on trust development between families and healthcare providers in pediatric surgical settings, which doesn’t fit into any existing Climate Change categories. Therefore, a new category related to healthcare trust could be suggested.
new_primary_category.quote: Improving communication and providing compassionate care, as well as encouraging a patient-centered approach, appear to be most effective in promoting trust in pediatric surgical and urgent settings.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: Since the paper is centered on pediatric surgical settings, creating a more specific sub-category within Healthcare Trust called Pediatric Healthcare might be suitable to capture its focus.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Our findings can guide future educational interventions towards strengthening parental trust and promoting child- and family-centered care in pediatric surgical settings.
